notes.title: Update v1.3 - Anomaly Edition
notes.content:
Mystic Watcher’s first big update!  

- A lot of anomalies have been changed and fixed  
- Updated anomaly photos  
- Added yes or no options when quitting the game  
- Added a skip dialogue option  
- Changed the cursor  
- Removed the Christmas Decorations (in a timely fashion...totally :> )  
- Adjusted the difficulties  
- Changed the menu box on the desktop  
- Fixed some art  
- Fixed some bugs with the animations  
- Enjoy and good luck finding those anomalies!!!  

Thank you for all your support, we hope to continue updating Mystic Watcher in the future :D Enjoy and good luck reporting those anomalies!!!

notes.title: ⋆｡˚❄️ Happy Holidays! ❄️˚ ｡⋆
notes.content:
Happy Holidays from everyone at Starspell Studio! 
- We've given the main menu and level 1 a festive update!
- We also fixed the glitching between dialogue in the intro!

We wish you all the best and hope you have a great rest of your year! Bigger updates are to be expected in the future, as we are working very hard to add more amazing content to [i]Mystic Watcher[/i]. 
We also want to thank everyone who has played our game. From the bottom of our hearts, we truly appreciate it, and we hope you enjoy [i]Mystic Watcher[/i] as much as we do <3
- From the Starspell Team, Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!
